title: CAM Assist Review Annotations Schema
description: Portable reviewer annotations that travel with federated manufacturing review workflows without mutating source packages.

record_version.description: Semantic version of the annotation record format

package_reference.description: Reference to the package being annotated. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

created_at.description: Non-blank string holding the ISO-8601 timestamp when this annotation file was created. This schema enforces non-blankness only (minLength + pattern reject empty and whitespace-only); whether the format: date-time annotation is asserted depends on the consuming validator's configuration, so the ISO-8601 shape may go unchecked.

annotations.description: List of review annotations. Annotations are informational only and do not grant execution authority.

reviewer.description: Informational reviewer identifier. No trust validation performed.

timestamp.description: String holding the ISO-8601 timestamp of the annotation. Known gap: no minLength/pattern guard here, so empty and whitespace-only values are accepted, unlike the created_at fields in these schemas; whether the format: date-time annotation is asserted depends on the consuming validator's configuration.

category.description: Free-text category (e.g., tooling, geometry, acoustic, runtime, safety, material, review)

annotations_are_informational.description: MUST be true. Annotations do not grant execution authority.

annotations_do_not_approve.description: MUST be true. Annotations do not constitute approval.
